credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Six (6) color card paint samples arranged in layers, laminated together,  representing an array of black to gray hues with an additional single black color card. Handwritten in ink are color notations.  On the verso of the singular black card, written in black ink, " May 23, 1937, Terra Cassel Milan and Zinc White Newman ground with Newman linseed oil and Venice Turpentine. On the verso of the black and gray color cards, written in blue ink are 3 cards with the word " zinc (?) and two cards with the word "Ivory".  Each color test was executed on an individual square of cardboard or heavy paper.  The squares, about 3" on average, present individual samples of saturated color.
title: Color Cards, Shades of Black to Gray
